hypothesis: A development-calibrated 13Z forecast both improves validation log loss by at least 2% versus calibrated 07Z and, when combined at a development-selected fixed weight with the market, improves market log loss by at least 2% without worsening Brier score.

temporal_split.test: none; a later disjoint cohort is required after validation pass

decision_rule.pass: Permit selection of a new disjoint confirmatory cohort; do not call this tradable edge.
decision_rule.fail: Reject this low-capacity 13Z incremental branch; do not tune on validation.
